question: Which species plays a keystone role in supporting insectivore populations with a year - round available food resource?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ficus species**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• **Ficus species** are known for producing fruit year-round, providing a consistent food resource for various insectivores.

• They play a critical role in forest ecosystems as keystone species, supporting a wide range of wildlife, including birds, bats, and other animals.

• The fruits of Ficus species, commonly known as figs, are highly nutritious and attract many different animal species.

• Ficus species are often considered keystone plants due to their ecological significance in maintaining biodiversity and supporting food webs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Keystone Species:**

• A keystone species is an organism that has a disproportionately large impact on its environment relative to its abundance.

• These species play a critical role in maintaining the structure of an ecological community, affecting many other organisms in the ecosystem.

• The removal of a keystone species can lead to significant changes in the ecosystem and possibly the collapse of the community structure.

• **Insectivores:**

• Insectivores are animals that primarily feed on insects and other small invertebrates.

• They play an important role in controlling insect populations and contributing to the balance of ecosystems.

• Many birds, mammals, and amphibians are insectivores, and they rely on a consistent supply of insects for their diet.

• **Ficus Species:**

• The genus Ficus includes around 850 species of trees, shrubs, and vines commonly known as fig trees or figs.

• Ficus species are found in diverse environments, from tropical rainforests to semi-arid regions.

• These plants are known for their unique fruit, the syconium, which is a hollow structure containing multiple flowers and seeds inside.

• Figs are a critical food resource for many wildlife species, providing nutrition during periods when other food sources are scarce.
